responsibility: This module groups shared middle-end and early back-end infrastructure that does not belong to a single optimization family but underpins GCC’s representation and lowering of functions, memory, types, and exceptional control flow. Its files cover language-independent tree conversion and storage-layout logic used to turn abstract types and expressions into canonical GCC representations; alias-analysis services that answer whether tree or RTL memory references may overlap; exception-handling region, landing-pad, and table management that bridges middle-end EH lowering to RTL and final emission; and the core per-function state machinery for creating, tracking, and expanding functions into RTL, including stack/frame bookkeeping and function ABI call-clobber modeling. It also includes the top-level compiler context and common backend-facing declarations that provide process-wide state and shared infrastructure. Together, these file families define miscellaneous but central compiler services used across front ends, generic lowering, and RTL generation, distinguishing this module from dedicated optimization or target-specific subsystems.
